---
title: "Mermaid Basic"
# bd-5m4ga0s1: a plain ```mermaid fenced block renders as
# <pre class="mermaid"> with the escaped diagram source, plus a single
# after-body <script src> + init pair calling mermaid.run(). The `-->`
# arrow doubles as the HTML-escaping probe (must appear as --&gt;).
#
# bd-mermaid-runtime-not-bundled-vxejw159: the runtime is BUNDLED, so
# the script src must be a relative path and jsDelivr must appear
# nowhere in the output. The negative pattern is the load-bearing one —
# it is what keeps a rendered site working offline.
_quarto:
  tests:
    html:
      noErrors: true
      ensureHtmlElements:
        - ["pre.mermaid"]
        - []
      ensureFileRegexMatches:
        - [
            "<pre class=\"mermaid\">",
            "flowchart LR",
            "a --&gt; b",
            "<script src=\"[^\"]*mermaid\\.min\\.js\"></script>",
            "mermaid\\.initialize\\(\\{ startOnLoad: false \\}\\)",
            "mermaid\\.run\\(\\{ querySelector: 'pre\\.mermaid' \\}\\)",
          ]
        - ["a --> b", "cdn\\.jsdelivr\\.net", "https?://"]
---

Before the diagram.

```mermaid
flowchart LR
  a --> b
```

After the diagram.
